subject: I'm glad we have so many damn tests, including the ones that test the output behavior

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: I'm glad we have so many damn tests, including the ones that test the output behavior
parts:
Just FYI, all these tests saved my ass as I tried to remove std::cout and std::cerr from our code base. Without it, I think I would have destroyed a lot of behavior including printing in generated quantities....


With that said, I think we should add end-to-end tests that are similar for all the interfaces.


Ben / Jiqiang, I'll try to update RStan appropriately for the branch for stan-dev/stan#699.
Allen, I'll try to figure out how to build PyStan appropriately so I can help out with the conversion.




Daniel
